rules.name: Hidden Drip Pricing & Sneak-into-Basket
rules.desc: Concealing mandatory fees, service surcharges, or auto-selected items until the final steps of a transaction.

rules.name: Confirmshaming & Manipulative Microcopy
rules.desc: Phrasing opt-out button text to guilt, insult, or shame the user into complying with the site's preferred choice.

rules.name: Visual Contrast Suppression
rules.desc: Making crucial terms, recurring billing conditions, or opt-out links nearly invisible using ultra-low contrast or microscopic fonts.

rules.name: Fake Urgency & Resetting Countdowns
rules.desc: Displaying artificial timers, countdowns, or claims of impending price hikes that automatically reset upon page reload.

rules.name: Fabricated Social Proof & Fake Activity
rules.desc: Generating synthetic notifications claiming other users just purchased the item or that high demand is depleting stock.

rules.name: Roach Motel / Trapped Cancellation
rules.desc: Making it effortless to subscribe (1-click), but requiring phone calls, maze-like forms, or hidden menus to cancel.

rules.name: Fake System Warnings & Rogue Dialogs
rules.desc: Simulating native operating system error dialogs, antivirus infection alerts, or browser crash screens to frighten users.

rules.name: Bait and Switch
rules.desc: Promising one outcome (e.g. clicking 'Close' or 'Skip') but executing an entirely different action (e.g. opening an ad or initiating checkout).
